query:
SELECT 
  id,
  organizationId,
  balance,
  periodAllowance,
  periodUsed,
  totalPurchased,
  totalUsed,
  updatedAt
FROM ai_credit_balance
WHERE organizationId = 120001
ORDER BY updatedAt DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT 
  id,
  organizationId,
  type,
  amount,
  balanceAfter,
  taskType,
  description,
  userId,
  createdAt
FROM ai_credit_transactions
WHERE organizationId = 120001
ORDER BY createdAt DESC
LIMIT 20;
